results.content: # DAAD - You want to become an AI expert? ## DAAD's Post. ### **DAAD**. You want to become an AI expert? The Konrad Zuse School of Excellence in Reliable AI (relAI) offers outstanding German and international students who plan to study a master’s course in AI-related disciplines at TU München (TUM) or Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) an excellent addition to their regular master programme, focusing on the mathematical and algorithmic foundations of reliable AI and targeting medicine & healthcare, robotics & interacting systems, and algorithmic decision-making as key application fields. The Zuse Schools are financed with funds from the Bundesministerium für Bildung und Forschung and focus on different aspects of AI research, providing excellent research-based education in Germany. The Zuse School relAI is embedded in the unique transdisciplinary Munich AI ecosystem, combining the expertise of the two Universities of Excellence TUM and LMU.
